_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Eŋu wo nyɔ Aglɔ {player_id} to Three-Player Tic Tac Toe me.
Wo ɖo nye '{symbol}'.
Wo wɔ na wɔn ɖo le tablo 5x5 me yi wɔ ɖo ɖe ɖi ɖe na ɖi ɖe.
Aze ɖe ɖi ɖe na ɖi ɖe si na ɖi ɖe ɖi ɖe, si na ɖi ɖe ɖi ɖe, kple si na ɖi ɖe ɖi ɖe.
Na yi wɔ na wɔn ɖo na '[4]' yi wɔ ɖo 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nuzinzan ɖo ɖi ɖo alɔ. Na yi '[cell]' si na ɖo le 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nuzinzan ɖo bubu: {cell}. Ega dona 0 kple {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: azɔvi {player_id} ɔ ɖè nùɖé bɔ̀ é nyí nǔtí ǎ.

game_action.placed: Aglɔ {player_id} wɔ na ɖo ({symbol}) le ɣeto me ({row}, {col}).
